title: Janitorial Walkthrough Service Request Form
subtitle: Janitorial Walkthrough: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Janitorial Walkthrough Service Request Form covers cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task. The facility cleaning coordinator records Janitorial Walkthrough need, timing, access, and assignment. Janitorial Walkthrough Service Request Form keeps Janitorial Walkthrough exceptions visible until the facility cleaning coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Janitorial Walkthrough Service Request Form at occupied rooms, restrooms, common areas, service closets, and restricted zones. Document cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task identity before Janitorial Walkthrough begins. Compare cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task findings with stated Janitorial Walkthrough criteria; route unresolved Janitorial Walkthrough issues to janitorial quality supervisor.

sections.title: Requested-service contact and source record
sections.guidance: For Janitorial Walkthrough, identify responsible parties, occupied rooms, restrooms, common areas, service closets, and restricted zones, and the linked cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task source.

sections.guidance: Capture Janitorial Walkthrough facts for cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Request constraints, assignment, and response
sections.guidance: Resolve open Janitorial Walkthrough request questions; have facility cleaning coordinator record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

items: Damaged surface or fixture outside cleaning scope
Restricted room or privacy boundary not cleared
Wet-floor or access control cannot be maintained
Prior or requester-supplied: prior zone condition and exception history

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Janitorial Walkthrough request when an unknown exposure, restricted-area concern, public slip risk, or unresolved damage remains. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to facility cleaning coordinator.
